_schema: signal-fleet hardening eval dataset v1 — deterministic (no LLM). Each case feeds a real (scrubbed) production signal through the DETERMINISTIC hardening (triage.operational_class / triage.triage gate / sources test-suppression) and asserts the behavior. Runner: mvp/eval_hardening.py. Cultivate: when a new incident class appears, add a case here with its real (scrubbed) strings + expected behavior. Provenance links the source incident.
_provenance: Derived from the 2026-08-13→19 chipi/podcast_scraper escalation flood (the triager was auth-broken -> fail-open -> ~128 issues). Strings are the real error titles, scrubbed (no secrets/PII). See docs/wip/signal-fleet-flood-hardening.md.
